s: threshold, brink, bump: particularly, a certain part of a sluice
threshold, brink, bump: particularly, an extension of the top floor of a building with a gabled roof
Drempel.et: From Middle High German drempel (“threshold”), either belonging to the words Treppe, trampeln etc. for which see Polish drabina, or to Middle High German drëmel (“bar”) from Old High German dremil, tremil (“bar”), German Dremel, Tremmel (“bar”).
